scripts.seed:staff-admin: tsc --target es2022 --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck scripts/bootstrap-staff-admin.ts --outDir .tmp/scripts && node .tmp/scripts/bootstrap-staff-admin.js
scripts.audit:staff: tsc --target es2022 --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck scripts/audit-staff-users.ts --outDir .tmp/scripts && node .tmp/scripts/audit-staff-users.js
scripts.test:compile: rm -rf .tmp/tests && tsc src/lib/utils/report-calculations.ts src/lib/auth/roles.ts src/lib/utils/public-url.ts --outDir .tmp/tests --module commonjs --target es2022 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --baseUrl src
scripts.test:emulator: npx --yes firebase-tools@14.16.0 emulators:exec --project qrapido-ci --only auth,firestore "node --test tests/emulator/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:e2e: npx --yes firebase-tools@14.16.0 emulators:exec --project qrapido-ci --only auth,firestore "npm run build && node tests/e2e/main-flow.mjs"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:emulator && npm run test:e2e
